title: Chipmaker Nvidia seeks to raise over $25B in first bond deal since 2021
brief: Nvidia is seeking to raise over $25 billion through its first bond sale since 2021, marking a significant debt issuance to test investor appetite for AI sector exposure as borrowing demand surges. The move demonstrates Nvidia's confidence in its market position and need for capital, likely to fund ongoing R&D, infrastructure, and shareholder returns amid intense competition in AI chip manufacturing.
